submitted.rationale: Fe-rich (hematite-like) compositions absorb at 2.1 eV. EQE rose steadily as the Fe fraction increased: -0.006% at index 14, 0.082% at index 4 and 0.162% at index 0. Index 0 is the most Fe-rich candidate in the library.

rejected.reason: Unmeasured. Their merit is expected to be negligible because EQE fell as Sb increased and Sb-rich oxides absorb poorly at 2.1 eV
